📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Every game, every genre, all of the Apple Arcade essentials you need to know about.

According to recent reports, if you get spoiled for choice when browsing through the Apple Arcade library, we can't blame you. There are well over 100 games in the incredible service, and you can spend hundreds of hours playing through them all. So the question is, where is best to spend your time? What is Apple Arcade? Apple Arcade is a subscription service that you can use on all of your Apple devices, including your iPhone, iPad, Apple TV or Mac. It allows you to play games from a list that includes over 180 games at the moment, and your progress is transferred between devices, meaning you can continue where you left off. It's really handy, and the Apple Arcade games list gets expanded often, so you'll always have new games to play.

Sources indicate that no matter what kind of game you're looking for, you'll find it on these pages. Here we've put together a comprehensive Apple Arcade games list of every title currently released, in the order of release, with the genres included so you can find exactly what you want.

Apple Arcade games list 2026 Just take a look below, and you'll find everything you need to know about every game that's on the Apple Arcade games list of 2026, sorted by genre and release date (latest first).

Crossy Road Rush (Hipster Whale).

According to recent reports, hipster Whale's blocky Frogger-like is running down a different path in Crossy Road Rush. Now, you'll dash across an island, hopping from place to place while trying to avoid colliding with walls and other obstacles.

Yes, the beloved survival crafting game is now available on Apple Arcade, complete with Dead Cells and Palworld crossover content.

River City Survivors (Arc System Works).

Get a healthy dose of bullet heaven in River City Survivors, which sees you slaying zombies while picking up equipment and synergies along the way.

Indulge in some classic arcade games like Pac-Man, Space Invaders, Galaga and a whole lot more.

Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm+ (Bandai Namco).

With controller support and dozens of characters, you can enjoy battles and stories from Naruto.

In a recent development, ever wanted to start your own cult? Well, now you have to. After being saved by an ominous stranger, you'll have to repay your debt by gathering him new and loyal followers. It won't be easy, though. You'll need to battle off hordes of enemies and take down other cult leaders to help boost your own.

Ah, Worms. For people of a certain age, it was a staple of their childhoods. Creating your little worm troop and then sending them into battle against your pals was always a joy. Now a newly introduced version is available on Apple Arcade, bringing those same turn-based tactics to the palm of your hand.

In a recent development, everyone's favourite grumpy avians are back with a slight twist. Rather than flinging themselves at their porcine foes, this time you'll take down the piggies in a brick breaker-style setup. Okay, so there's still an element of flinging.

Much like Triband's previous efforts, What the Clash? is another wacky fun time that sees you competing – either solo or co-op – in numerous party games.

SpaceInvaders InfinityGene Evo (Taito Corporation).

SpaceInvaders InfinityGene Evo is, as the name suggests, an evolved version of the classic arcade shooter. Sporting the gameplay we all know and love, it throws in a few twists to help breathe new life into this familiar setup.

Katamari Damacy Rolling Live (Bandai Namco).

Everything you need to know is pretty much in the title. Katamari Damacy sees you rolling a stick ball that grows bigger as more and more items become stuck to it.

Pac-Man continues to be relevant in the gaming world and 256+ allows you to enjoy even more dot-munching action.

Recent findings suggest that drive Ahead! Carcade (Dodreams Fairytale Firm).

Ever have the urge to drive recklessly? Well, here you can live out those bizarre fantasies with no real-world consequences! In Cardcade, the goal is to bonk your opponent in the head once. Yep, that's all it takes, which means it's not as simple as it sounds in practice.

Arkanoid vs Space Invaders+ (Taito Corporation).

Arkanoid vs Space Invaders+ combines the two classic games in one, tasking you with defending the Earth by deflecting bullets back at your foes.

Poncle's excellent Vampire Survivors is now available through Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it's a bullet heaven game where your character automatically flings a barrage of projectiles at your enemies, leaving you only worrying about walking away from any incoming danger.

Temple Run: Legends (Imangi Studios).

One of the most iconic mobile games is back, albeit with a slight twist. In Temple Run: Legends, there are levels to complete rather than the endless dash we're used to. On each, there are three stars to earn on the one-hundred-plus levels, so your swiping skills need to be on point.

Punch Kick Duck+ (Shaun Coleman).

Battle your way to the top of the tower where success lies in how good your timing is and whether or not you pick the right move.

Tomb of the Mask+ (Happymagenta).

Tomb of the Mask is an arcade action game that sees you exploring a tomb.

A Slight Chance of Sawblades+ (Yong Kian Chin).

In a strange and dangerous turn of events, it's raining saw blades. To survive the deadly storm, you must dodge, jump and backflip away from the tools dropping from the sky.

BEAST: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team (Oh BiBi).

Industry observers note that beast is a 3v3 shooter that sees you battling for the honour of your home planet. During each match, you can switch between pet and beast forms, making use of the different abilities and weapons each brings.

Everyone's favourite speed hedgehog comes to Apple Arcade to do battle with his old foe Eggman. Choosing one of six playable characters, you will dash, climb, and fly your way through each of the stages.

It has been revealed that as the name heavily suggests, Downwell sees you making your way down a well in search of treasure. To defend yourself, you are equipped with a pair of Gunboots to vanquish the threats that lurk within the well.

Taken on the role of James Bond in this top-down action adventure that draws inspiration from the last 60 years of the storied hero.

Junkworld is a tower defence where you take charge of the Scavenger clan and lead them to victory in a series of battle, making use of towers, special units and gadgets.

Ridiculous Fishing EX (Vlambeer).

A fishing game with a difference, Ridiculous Fishing EX sees you using guns, chainsaws, and even toasters as you head into the depths in search of a substantial catch.

TMNT Splintered Fate (Viacom International).

Join everyone's favourite turtle quartet in this brand-new roguelike action game. Splinter has been captured and it's up to you to save him. You can play as any of the four Turtles, each with distinct abilities and powers alongside teaming up with three other players.

Time Locker is a shooter with a minimalist but colourful aesthetic. In it, you control the speed of time using your finger and must avoid obstacles and enemy attacks. The Apple Arcade version comes with upcoming exclusive enemies.

In a recent development, temple Run is one of mobile gaming's all-time classics. If, somehow, you're unfamiliar, it sees you running, jumping, and sliding through temples, collecting riches as you go.

Industry observers note that snake.io+ is a battle royale that sees you slithering around and eating pellets in a bid to become the last serpent standing. By cutting up other snakes, you can make them explode into pellets, which you'll want to gobble up to increase your size.

It has been revealed that PPKP stands for Punch Punch Kick Punch, which gives you a rough idea of what to expect. You will attempt to save a city from deadly monsters by honing your martial arts skills so you can unleash a devastating combo to defeat them.

Getting Over It+(Bennett Foddy).

It has been revealed that navigate a world covered in random everyday objects by playing as a man in a pot wielding a hammer. It's as frustrating as it is odd, but ultimately rewarding if you manage to scale the mountain that lies ahead of you.

JellyCar Worlds (Walaber Entertainment).

As the title suggests, in this driving/platforming action game, you play as a car made of bouncy jelly. With this in mind and armed with several abilities, the aim is simple. Navigate each level and find the exit.

Motion Twins' excellent roguelike can now be enjoyed as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. It sees you playing as a failed experiment, setting off to explore wildly different biomes.

Jetpack Joyride 2 (Halfbrick Studios).

Industry observers note that barry Streakfries has returned. Once more, he will need to battle through the laboratory and attempt to put an end to the experiments being carried out there.

Subway Surfers Tag (Sybo Games).

The latest entry in the popular Subway Surfers series is an Apple Arcade exclusive. In Subway Surfers Tag, you will head to numerous city locations and skate, grind, and tag your way to a high score. The Guard will be there to make things more tricky though, so be ready to evade him.

Pick your favourite Sonic the Hedgehog character before running, jumping and dashing through plenty of levels. Alongside regular running levels, you will also face off against Eggman and Zac in special Boss Racing stages.

Alto's Adventure – Remastered (Snowman).

Alto's Adventure is a mobile classic that sees players embarking on a snowboarding adventure where they'll grind over rooftops and leap across perilous chasms. The remastered version includes fresh challenges for players to tackle and several new set pieces.

Disney Melee Mania (Mighty Bear Games).

According to recent reports, disney Melee Mania is a MOBA that features a variety of characters from the franchise's many popular films. Each match lasts five minutes, making it great for playing on the go, and there are at the moment 12 Champions to choose from, including Buzz Lightyear and Wreck-It Ralph.

Oddmar sees the titular character embarking on a journey to prove himself worthy of a place in Valhalla. Along the way, he will collect magically imbued weapons and shields that will help him smite down his foes.

Get a blast of nostalgia with Galaga Wars+, which sees you taking control of the iconic spaceships and gunning down waves and waves of enemies.

According to recent reports, play as a cute bird who has always dreamed of flying. Run down hills to use them as jumps to soar through the air, if only for a moment.

The extremely popular Crossy Road is now available on Apple Arcade, allowing you to collect all the characters and the numerous stages as part of your subscription.

Sources indicate that the popular endless runner is now available on Apple Arcade. Fly through several levels using a bullet-powered jetpack as Barry Steakfries looks to put an end to a group of scientists who are up to no good.

In a recent development, alto's Odyssey: The Lost City is the definitive version of the gorgeous endless runner. It features an all-newly introduced biome for players to explore alongside additional challenges to beat.

The classic slingshot action game returns with fresh birds, pigs and challenges. There's also a brand new game mode to enjoy where players are tasked with stopping the Eagles from wreaking havoc on the island.

Sources indicate that leo's Fortune is a platformer where you will hunt down a fiend who rudely stole your gold. The game has received a lot of praise since it first debuted, and now you can play it as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

A retro-fueled underwater adventure where you can create your own soundtrack.

Compete with players from around the world in hyper-casual competitive mini-games or throw a Super Mega Mini Party with friends!

This is an action driving game where you'll be swerving around corners, collecting upcoming powers, and shooting down choppers, all while zipping past bullets.

Bleak Sword is a dark fantasy action game tasking players to struggle across compact, cursed diorama battlefields.

The floor is lava, so you'd best stay off it any way you can.

Build your way to the top in this lighthearted, team-action brawler where anything can happen.

Creatures of the Deep+ (Infinite Dreams Inc).

Fancy going fishing? That's exactly what you can do in Creatures of the Deep, heading out in your little boat in search of an impressive catch. But be aware that disturbing shadows are lurking in the deep...

Oceanhorn 3 (Cornfox & Brothers).

In a recent development, the third main instalment in the Zelda-like series takes place 1000 years after Oceanhorn 2, bringing you a completely fresh adventure. You'll have to battle through the Shadow Sea, which doesn't sound like a pleasant place for a cruise.

SpongeBob: Patty Pursuit (Viacom).

In a recent development, head down to Bikini Bottom for some side-scrolling action with everyone's favourite sponge. He's on a mission to find his missing fry cook station while Plankton joins him because his inventions have also been stolen.

Return to Monkey Island+ (Terrible Toybox).

This one's for the point-and-click adventure fans out there, particularly those who have previously enjoyed Ron Gilbert's work.

In this adventure, you'll form a team of Ubisoft's critters and use their special powers to vanquish your foes.

Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom (Bandai Namco Entertainment).

In this colourful game, your goal is to restore the titular kingdom to its former glory by building and decorating your wilderness camp before inviting your Tamagotchi pals to enjoy it with you.

From the creators of What the Golf? Comes What the Car?, a silly racing game where you can roll, jump, fly and even sneeze your way to the finish line. You play as a car, but rather than having wheels, you have a pair of legs. It's as fun as it is absurd.

Very Little Nightmares+ (Bandai Namco).

Very Little Nightmares is a puzzle adventure game where you are tasked with escaping The Nest, a giant maze littered with traps.

Recent findings suggest that enjoy the incredibly atmospheric Limbo as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You play as a young boy who is looking for his sister and must traverse a deadly world to find her by solving puzzles and jumping over perilous gaps.

Old Man's Journey+ (Broken Rules).

Old Man's Journey+ is an emotional adventure that focuses on life's precious moments and intends that need to be changed.

Monument Valley 2+ (ustwo games).

Industry observers note that the critically acclaimed adventure game Monument Valley 2 is now available through Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it sees players guiding a mother and her child through a world filled with magical architecture.

Gibbon: Beyond the Trees (Broken Rules).

It has been revealed that the developers of Old Man's Journey and ELOH has returned with a game that looks to emulate the way gibbons swing from tree to tree. Meanwhile, the narrative tackles topics such as deforestation, poaching, and climate change.

Industry observers note that wylde Flowers is a life and farming sim, but with magical spells thrown in for good measure. You take on the role of Tara, who arrives on the island to help her grandma with the family farm. It promises to provide a whole adventure as you explore magical realms, beaches and forests.

Dandara: Trials of Fear+ (Raw Fury).

Recent findings suggest that raw Fury's Metroidvania Dandara: Trials of Fear can now be enjoyed as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. It sees you battling to save the world of Salt from an imminent collapse.

LEGO Star Wars: Castaways (Gameloft).

Sources indicate that in Star Wars: Castaways, you will explore a mysterious planet that has been abandoned for a long time. Throughout the game, you will make new friends and battle against some imposing enemies.

In Monument Valley, you will manipulate impossible architecture and guide a silent princess through a stunningly beautiful world.

A modern twist on the trials and tribulations of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the global phenomenon will immerse players in exhilarating journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the completely wild.

A beautiful adventure game that explores how everyone can make a difference in the world even with the smallest of actions.

According to recent reports, all of You is a cute, purely visual, accessible, family-friendly puzzle adventure with unique gameplay. Play and pause time in every part of the level to unveil the right path for the main character.

The Last Campfire is an adventure, a story of a lost ember trapped in a puzzling place, searching for meaning and a way home.

In a recent development, the ground starts shaking, light bulbs are breaking - and something rather unusual is happening right behind the walls of your very room. Equipped with nothing but wit and courage, you slowly descend into a world inhabited by avian folk and seemingly deadly furniture monsters.

Sequel to the classic adventure game Beneath a Steel Sky.

Beyond Blue takes you into the near future, where you’ll have the opportunity to explore the mysteries of our ocean through the eyes of Mirai, a deep-sea explorer and scientist.

Live the life of a Sasquatch and do regular, everyday Sasquatch stuff like: Sneak around campsites. Disguise yourself in human clothing.

FreeCell Solitaire: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

Recent findings suggest that pretty much as it says on the tin. FreeCell Solitaire lets you enjoy the classic card game in as straightforward a way as possible. No bells and whistles needed here.

Uno: Arcade Edition (Mattel163).

If ruining long-standing friendships is your idea of fun, then you might want to give Uno: Arcade Edition a try. It's the classic card game we all love to get frustrated by with a few intriguing twists to the existing formula.

Crazy Eights: Card Games+ (MobilityWare).

Sources indicate that dip into some of your favourite tabletop card games with Crazy Eights. It has numerous modes to enjoy that mix up the rules, helping keep things fresh.

Texas Hold'em Poker: Pokerist+ (KamaGames).

No real surprises here, simply a way to play poker online, pitting your skills against other players to win massive.

LocalThunk's Balatro exploded in popularity when it released early in 2024. The simple concept of creating strong poker hands combined with deckbuilding, tactics and even some maths has led to it being viewed as one of the best games of the year. And now you can play it on your phone!

Monster Train+ (Good Shepherd Entertainment).

If you haven't played this excellent roguelike deckbuilder and happen to have an Apple Arcade subscription, you're now in luck. Monster Train sees you riding on the titular locomotive on a journey to restore a frozen hell to its former glory. Well, if hell is ever glorious, I suppose.

Blackjack by Mobility (Mobility Ware).

This one's fairly self-explanatory, you can play the card game 21. You have unlimited chips too, so you can play against the dealer to your heart's content.

Pocket Card Jockey: Ride On (Game Freak).

Pocket Card Jockey: Ride On is a game that combines solitaire and horse racing. The game previously released on Nintendo 3DS but is now available as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

Gin Rummy Classic+ (MobilityWare).

It has been revealed that learn to play Gin Rummy using tutorials and perfect your skills against bots offline. The aim is simple: you want to create the best hand possible by picking up or drawing one card at a time.

Spider Solitaire: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

Enjoy the classic card game Spider Solitaire as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

Hearts: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

Recent findings suggest that now you can enjoy the classic card game Hearts as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You can test your skills against AI that adapts to your playstyle to make sure you stay on your toes.

Experience the classic card game with a plethora of beautiful deck designs, daily challenges and explore your competitive nature by trying to climb the leaderboards.

The addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.

Like its footwear namesake — Flipflop Solitaire is unrestrictive, creating a fresh game for fans of spider, klondike and other traditional Solitaires.

Pusheen's Place (Electric Square).

Sources indicate that if the idea of adorable cat-like creatures appeals to you, then Pusheens is worth checking out. You'll gather a veritable army of them before popping them in their new home, which you can also customise.

Unpacking is a Zen puzzler that sees you moving house several times over a period of time. It's entirely designed for relaxing, so you don't have to worry about timers, scores or any of that business. Just kick back and enjoy.

A bunch of evil monsters and villains need serving, and it's up to you to fulfil their orders.

According to recent reports, the most famous and most popular endless runner is now available on Apple Arcade. Race along those tracks and grab coins to your heart's content without fear of any adverts of in-app purchases required.

According to recent reports, cleaning might not sound fun on the surface, but trust me, you'll love it in PowerWash Simulator. Armed with a powerful jet washer, you'll have to blast the muck off house, vehicles and other objects until they're spick and span. It's incredibly satisfying.

Piffle+ sees you slinging adorable cats around levels to break all the blocks. It's a simple premise, but trickier to do in practice.

Industry observers note that suika Game is deceptively simple. All you have to do is get two of the same fruit to come into contact with one another so they merge to form a larger fruit, with the ultimate goal being to create a watermelon. It sounds straightforward and perhaps a little dull, but before you know it, an hour's passed and you'll be itching to make more watermelons.

Helix Jump tasks you with guiding your ball through a series of twisted towers using physics-based movement.

Industry observers note that there are few games as synonymous with mobile as Doodle Jump, and now this classic is available on Apple Arcade. The concept is simple, yet inherently compulsive. You can waste many hours on this one.

Talking Tom Blast Park (Outfit7).

Another entry in Outfit7's popular franchises, Talking Tom Blast Park sees the titular hero embarking on an adventure to stop Rakoonz.

In a recent development, smash Hit+ sees you smash through an ethereal dimension in time with music. It promises to be a meditative experience despite the destruction you're leaving in your wake.

In a recent development, while Furista is a push as a pun, I'm happy for it count as a fan of felines. In this game, you adopt cats before matching your customers with them to make their visit to your cafe as fluffy and enjoyable as possible.

Industry observers note that collect and nurture fish so they become what they were always destined to be... Dragons! That's right. Zen Koi Pro+ is a relaxing experience that follows the Asian myth that koi can become dragons with enough care and attention.

Delicious – Miracle of Life+ (GameHouse).

Recent findings suggest that the popular casual management sim is now part of Apple Arcade. It follows Emily as she looks to progress her career while preparing to become a parent.

Recent findings suggest that if you've ever wanted to build your own farm, this might be the game for you. Farmside allows you to place plots, plant crops and harvest them. Beyond that, you can raise animals and spend time designing your farm's layout.

In a recent development, 2017's App Store Game of the Year is now available through Apple Arcade. The aim is simple, you have to search for the titular hidden folks across numerous levels. There are over 300 in total with 32 hand-drawn areas to investigate.

It has been revealed that another of MobilityWare's card games is now available on Apple Arcade. This time you can play Spades as much as you'd like. The aim is to work with a partner to try and out-bid your opponents while trying to reach 250 points first.

It has been revealed that now you can enjoy the classic card game Hearts as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You can test your skills against AI that adapts to your playstyle to make sure you stay on your toes.

Experience the classic card game with a plethora of beautiful deck designs, daily challenges and explore your competitive nature by trying to climb the leaderboards.

The addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.

Like its footwear namesake — Flipflop Solitaire is unrestrictive, creating a new game for fans of spider, klondike and other traditional Solitaire games.

Blast off into outer space with an intergalactic indie rock band in the latest instalment in the popular Reigns series.

Bring your friends and see how far you can get in this endless spinning tower of arcade fun! Keep climbing as high as you can. Every run is different.

Would you believe me if I told you that there's a puzzler about folding paper that's incredibly beautiful? If you're an origami fan, most likely. But to anyone else, it'll be a pleasant surprise in Kami 2+.

Block Blast is one of those simple yet endlessly engaging puzzlers. All you have to do is match blocks on an 8-by-8 grid and then enjoy them all exploding. However, it's never quite that simple, constantly asking you to think deeper than you might expect.

Art of Fauna: Cosy Puzzles+ (Klemens Strasser).

In a recent development, if you love nature and puzzles, then Art of Fauna is perfect for you. It sees you essentially putting together some beautiful artwork, with each accompanied by some text about the depicted animal.

Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+ (Tripledot Studios).

A colourful and relaxing puzzler that will keep you occupied for hours and hours.

Everyday Puzzles: Mini Games+ (Fanatee).

Industry observers note that it's a bunch of puzzles you can do every day, right? Pretty much! There is a mix of word puzzles and brain teasers for you to tackle each day to keep your mind strong.

Fancy yourself as an artist? Draw It gives you the opportunity to prove it, tasking you with sketching out a visual depiction of a word before the time runs out.

Perchang World (Perchang World).

Perchang is a physics-based puzzler that takes you through a series of colour environments. It's wacky fun that's all narrated by popular British comedian, James Acaster.

Flow Free is as simple as puzzlers can get. However, don't expect it to be easy. Connect up colours might sound straightforward, but it becomes very tricky over time.

If you love pretty colours and solving puzzles, then I Love Hue Too+ is for you. It sees you rearranging mosaic tiles to make beautiful creations.

Let's Go Mightycat! (ponos corporation).

The Battle Cats now have a spin-off! Now you can fling them at blocky towers. It might sound straightforward, but making them all tumble to the ground isn't as easy as you might think.

Lost in Play+ (Snapbreak Games).

Lost in Play is a story about a brother and sister trying to find their way home. To do so, you will need to solve a series of puzzles alongside chatting with some whimsical creatures.

Words of Wonders: Search+ (Fugo Bilism).

No great surprises here, Words of Wonder: Search+ is... a word search! That's right. It pretty much does exactly what it notes on the tin. So if hunting for a list of words is your jam, you're well catered to here.

Sumi Sumi: Matching Puzzle+ (Imagineer Co. Ltd).

Sumi Sumi is a puzzler that tasks you with matching popular characters from San-X together while enjoying all the beautiful animations that accompany doing so.

What do you get if you mix stickers with jigsaws? puffies. That's what! Designed to be a calming experience, it tasks you with open sticker packs before piecing together the various puzzles.

Put your word skills to the test with Zynga's Arcade edition of the popular puzzler Boggle.

Wheel of Fortune Daily (Frosty Pop).

If you're a fan of Wheel of Fortune and fans of daily puzzles, this game is exactly what you're looking. Each day, you will have to solve one, with plenty of variety promising to keep it fresh every time.

Enjoy some match-3 puzzling with a delightful cast of colourful characters.

Super Monsters Ate My Condo+ (PikPok).

Super Monsters Ate My Condo brings some whacky match-3 to the table. This new and updated version offers improved visuals but, thankfully, leaves the gameplay we all know and love untouched.

The popular tile-matching puzzler comes to Apple Arcade. It sees you popping the titular Puyos across several different game modes.

Words in Progress sees you combining letters to create words. You can either find how long you can survive in Endless Mode or test your word crafting prowess against other players.

Cornsweeper promises to be a meditative puzzler where the aim is to avoid explosions going off. It draws heavy inspiration from Minesweeper, as you might have guessed by the name!

Puzzle & Dragons Story (GungHo Online Entertainment).

Sources indicate that the popular series brings its blend of match-3 puzzling and RPG elements to Apple Arcade. By matching colours, you will battle your way through deadly dungeons while recruiting new companions to help you in the fight.

Knotwords is a word puzzler that brings together elements of Sudoku and crosswords.

Crossword Jam+ (PlaySimple Games).

Train your brain by engaging with a series of crossword-style games that see you looking to create words.

Om Nom is back in the third instalment in the popular puzzler series. The aim is to reunite Nibble Nom and Om Nom on each stage by engaging with the various mechanics that the game has to offer.

Industry observers note that finity. is a matching game with three simple rules to follow. But that doesn't mean it's going to be easy as you attempt to climb the leaderboards.

Sources indicate that nekograms is an adorable puzzler where the goal is to help every cat you encounter fall asleep. To do this, you have to move the felines and cushions around until they've found the perfect place to curl into a ball and nap.

It has been revealed that bold Moves+ is a puzzler where you match tiles to solve a series of word puzzles. It offers a mixture of daily and weekly events alongside plenty of levels to work through.

Disney SpellStruck (Artist Arcade).

Disney SpellStruck is a word puzzler that takes place on The Isles of Tiles. It tasks you with solving a bunch of crossword-like games with popular Disney and Pixar characters like Mickey Mouse, Stitch, and Tinkerbell.

Disney Getaway Blast+ (Gameloft).

Make your way through a series of matching puzzle games while working on your own tropical island. Along the way, you can get help from beloved Disney and Pixar characters, with each bringing special power-ups.

Doctor Who: An Unlikely Heist (Tilting: Point).

If you enjoy the popular BBC sci-fi series and puzzlers, then Doctor Who: An Unlikely Heist might be for you. It sees you finding hidden objects and solving a series of puzzles.

Human: Fall Flat+ is now available on Apple Arcade. It's a jokey physics-based platformer that can be enjoyed on your own or with four pals.

Castle Crumble (Orbital Knight).

In a recent development, if the title didn't make it clear enough, Castle Crumble is all about toppling strongholds. Using a mixture of explosives and spells, you will travel through different time periods destroying castles as you go.

Illustrated is a puzzler where the solutions lie in the images in front of you as well as the story. When you beat each story, each illustration is unveiled in full colour.

Industry observers note that as the name implies, stitch. is a game all about embroidery. The aim is to fill in each area without leaving any gaps. The game calls them Hoops, and they come in different shapes and sizes, ranging from landscapes to plants to animals.

Garden Tails: Match and Grow (Playdots).

In a recent development, garden Tails: Match and Grow is a relaxing puzzler for fans of wildlife and nature. It sees you building your own garden by completing match-3 puzzles to unlock upcoming flowers, bushes and critters.

Jigsaw Puzzle by MobilityWare+ (MobilityWare).

Jigsaw Puzzle is exactly what it indicates on the tin. You can sit back, relax, and solve a series of jigsaw puzzles. There are 26,000 of them in total from well-known brands, including Disney and Hasbro.

Prune is a beautiful game that serves as a love letter to nature, and specifically trees. It sees you growing and shaping your tree with simple swipe controls. The goal is to guide them towards the sunlight while avoiding the many dangers the world presents.

Moonshot – A Journey Home (Noodlecake).

Moonshot is a physics-based puzzler that tasks you with guiding Moon Pi – a moon who has become separated from Earth – back home. It uses drag and release mechanics as you launch Moon Pi past the gravity fields of other planets. There are also other obstacles to dodge, such as black holes and aliens.

Sources indicate that as the title suggests, Bridge Constructor tests players' bridge assembly prowess across 40 levels. You will need to make sure they can withstand constant use from cars and other heavy vehicles like trucks and super-heavy tank trucks.

Splitter Critters+ (RAC7 Games).

Recent findings suggest that splitter Critters is a cute puzzler where the aim is to guide the little creatures safely back to their spaceship. To do this you will be able to split the world into different pieces to create a path the critters can traverse.

Temple Run: Puzzle Adventure is a match-3 take on the well-known franchise. You will look to create powerful combs to make special pieces that allow you to become a Temple Champion.

Zookeeper World is a match-3 puzzler that allows players to create their own zoo. The more levels they beat, the more animals, plants and accessories they'll unlock to use in their zoo.

Checkers, your fresh free checker game (also known as Draughts), will entertain you for hours! It’s challenging with 5 different levels, yet relaxing and beautiful with 8 different designs.

When the tranquillity of suburban life is threatened by a huge building site, Simon and his cat mobilise the neighbours to help restore the mysterious wasteland before the diggers destroy it all.

A 3-D colour-matching game that sees players being tasked with toppling a series of mysterious towers that have appeared in the kingdom.

A quiet, sombre adventure best experienced with a loved one.

Eat loads of pills and pellets while chasing ghosts with your friends!

Embark on an epic hand-animated adventure from Zach Gage, Pendleton Ward, and Choice Provisions. Cast powerful spells, slay fantastic monsters, discover ancient secrets, and ultimately save the world — just by picking up the right cards.

Sources indicate that dear Reader lets you curl up and play your favourite books, turning classic literature into clever word puzzles. Unscramble passages from famous books, unlock unique puzzles and add new books to your library.

It has been revealed that grindstone is a puzzle-meets-action hybrid that will see you slashing through dozens of meaningless monsters on a path of destruction and carnage. Beautiful.

Patterned is a unique puzzle game that immerses you in the beauty and joy of seamless, repeating patterns.

In a recent development, tint lets you solve puzzles by painting. Mix watercolours to match the colour of the origami - all at a soothing pace and in the comfort of your own garden studio.

Recent findings suggest that where Cards Fall is a slice-of-life story where you build houses of cards to bring formative memories to life. Create pathways through dreamlike spatial puzzles to navigate the insecurities and emotions of high school and beyond.

Lego Hill Climb Adventures+ (Fingersoft).

Lego Hill Climb Adventures brings a mixture of exploration, racing, and upgrading to the table, all presented with everyone's favourite building blocks.

Lego Friends Heartlake Rush+ (StoryToys Limited).

Hop in various Lego vehicles and race through Heartlake City in high-octane action that sees you dodging traffic and roadblocks on your journey to be the fastest pile of bricks on the course.

Hot Wheels: Race Off+ (Hutch Games).

Enjoy some Hot Wheels-branded racing action in this game with all the loop the loops you could ever hope for.

Hill Climb Racing+ (Fingersoft).

Industry observers note that the classic game is now available on Apple Arcade. You play as Bill, an aspiring uphill racer as he drives a series of unique vehicles up hills and over obstacles.

Horizon Chase 2 is a fast-paced arcade racer with gameplay inspired by the genre's best entries from the '90s.

Gear.Club Stradale is all about supercars. You and your friends can start your own club in Tuscany, Italy and drive expensive cars from manufacturers like Bugatti, Porsche and McLaren.

Race with your favourite characters from several beloved cartoons, such as American Dad!, Family Guy, King of the Hill and Solar Opposite.

Enjoy Gameloft's popular racing game without any microtransactions. There are over 250 licensed vehicles from the likes of Ferrari, Ducati, Lamborghini and many more.

Race on mobile with Sonic and his friends.

Dungeon Clawler+ (Stray Fawn Studio).

Sources indicate that dungeon Clawler is a roguelike deckbuilder that uses the claw machine as a way to grab various items. It's a fun twist on the usual formula, and this claw actually grabs things, unlike those you find in UK arcades.

Hyke: Northerine Light(s) (Akatsuki Games).

If you like your RPGs doused in pixelated goodness, then you might want to check out Hyke. Playing as the titular character, you set out on a journey to find your missing mother. Along the way, Hyke's witch powers will come in handy against the threats you face.

It has been revealed that black Salt Games' excellent Dredge has now moored on Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it's essentially a relaxing fishing sim, until it suddenly isn't. You see, Eldritch nightmares are lurking in the depths that will do their best to destroy your humble vessel.

Final Fantasy IV: The After Years+ (Square Enix).

Ever wondered what happened after Final Fantasy IV? Well, in The After Years, you can play out that tale. This version is a full 3D remake too, so it looks better than ever.

Final Fantasy IV (3D Remake) + (Square Enix).

You can now play the 1991 classic on your iPhone or iPad with additional features compared to the original.

Stardew Valley+ (Concerned Ape).

#98366. A decades-old mystery about light could hold the key to faster internet

A decades-old mystery about light could hold the key to faster internet

📅 21 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (1057 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Sciencedaily

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • According to recent reports, light can carry vast amounts of information, but developing faster and more efficient optical communication systems requires precise control over how it travels.
  • A research team led by KAIST has uncovered detailed information about how light moves through BTO and how much of it the material absorbs.
  • According to recent reports, KAIST (President Choongsik Bae) revealed the results on November 8.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, light can carry vast amounts of information, but developing faster and more efficient optical communication systems requires precise control over how it travels. Scientists have now made an key advance in understanding barium titanate (BTO), a promising material that could help improve the performance of future devices that transmit information using light.

A research team led by KAIST has uncovered detailed information about how light moves through BTO and how much of it the material absorbs. These properties have been difficult to measure accurately for decades because of the crystal's complicated internal structure. The fresh findings provide engineers with a more reliable foundation for designing optical devices that minimize signal loss and support faster data transmission.

According to recent reports, KAIST (President Choongsik Bae) revealed the results on November 8. The research was led by Professor Min Seok Jang of KAIST's School of Electrical Engineering, working with Professor Harry A. Atwater's group at the California Institute of Technology (Caltech), the Korea Research Institute of Standards and Science (KRISS), and U.S.-based J.A. Woollam Co. Together, the researchers examined how BTO interacts with light across wavelengths extending from the ultraviolet to the far-infrared.

Why Barium Titanate Could Transform Optical Communications.

Recent findings suggest that one of BTO's most valuable characteristics is its ability to change how it affects light when electricity is applied. This behavior, called the Pockels effect, gives the material a strong electro-optic response and makes it especially attractive for optical modulators. These components convert electrical information into signals carried by light, making them vital building blocks for advanced communication systems.

However, producing reliable devices requires a detailed understanding of two fundamental optical properties. The refractive index describes how light travels through a material, while the extinction coefficient indicates how strongly the material absorbs it. Engineers need both measurements to predict how light will behave inside a waveguide, a structure designed to direct light along a specific path, and how much of the optical signal may be lost.

Getting consistent measurements from BTO has been surprisingly challenging. The material can contain multiple microscopic regions, called domains, in which the crystal structure points in different directions. Because these regions interact with light differently, measurements of an entire sample can combine several distinct responses. This has contributed to widely conflicting reports of BTO's optical properties over many decades.

Solving a Decades-Old Mystery About Light.

To overcome this problem, the researchers used a sophisticated measurement method known as Mueller matrix spectroscopic ellipsometry. The technique examines how the polarization of light changes when light reflects from or passes through a material, allowing scientists to investigate its optical behavior in detail.

In a recent development, rather than relying on crystals containing a complicated mixture of differently oriented regions, the team studied two types of single-crystal samples with relatively consistent domain orientations. This approach helped minimize overlapping optical responses and allowed the researchers to identify the material's underlying properties more accurately.

Industry observers note that their measurements spanned wavelengths from 190 nanometers (nm) to 40 micrometers (μm), covering an exceptionally broad range of light from ultraviolet to far-infrared. Since a material's optical behavior changes with wavelength, the scientists divided the spectrum into three regions and applied a different analytical approach to each. This revealed how BTO's refractive index and light absorption depend on both wavelength and crystal orientation.

Recent findings suggest that the researchers also investigated a particularly important range in which BTO allows nearly all incoming light to pass through. By combining ellipsometry with separate measurements of light transmission, they detected extremely low absorption, determining extinction coefficients of approximately 10-5 in the 2-10 μm wavelength range. These precise values will help engineers estimate how much light is lost as it travels through or remains confined within optical components.

It has been revealed that in another advance, the team developed a way to predict the combined optical behavior of crystals containing multiple domains. Their method uses the orientations of those domains and the proportion of the crystal occupied by each to calculate the material's overall response to light.

Opening the Door to Faster Data Transmission and Quantum Technology.

In a recent development, the results could make the development of future optical devices more predictable and efficient. With accurate information about BTO's behavior, engineers can model how light will travel through components of different shapes and dimensions before manufacturing them. They can also better estimate absorption losses, potentially reducing the need for repeated prototypes, costly redesigns, and extensive testing.

It has been revealed that the potential benefits extend beyond conventional optical communications. BTO could also play an crucial role in devices that produce light at different wavelengths, as well as photonic circuits that use light to process quantum information. Such technologies depend on controlling light with exceptional precision.

"This study reveals the optical response of barium titanate, which had long remained unclear, and provides a reliable reference for how the material interacts with light," remarked Professor Min Seok Jang.

In a recent development, jang also emphasized that the findings could contribute to optical communication devices capable of transmitting data faster while reducing light loss. The improved understanding of BTO may also support the development of quantum photonic technologies, where precise manipulation of light is essential.

In a recent development, the study was published online on October 20, 2026, in ACS Photonics. Jiwon Kang, a Ph.D. candidate in KAIST's School of Electrical Engineering, and Dr. Nina Hong of J.A. Woollam Co. served as co-first authors. Professors Min Seok Jang of KAIST and Harry A. Atwater of Caltech were the corresponding authors.

It has been revealed that funding was provided through the Culture, Sports and Tourism R&D Program administered by the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA), with support from the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism; the Basic Science Research Program administered by the National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF), with support from the Ministry of Education; the Ministry of Science and ICT; and the U.S. Air Force Office of Scientific Research (AFOSR).

Heartopia finally gets a release date... on everything but Steam

📅 22 Dec 2025 | ⏱️ 1 min read (280 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Vg247

⏱️ ~1 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Heartopia developer XD Games has delivered the news anyone who tried out the life sim game had been waiting for.
  • According to recent reports, the Steam version won’t actually launch on that date, and will instead go live at some other point in the future.
  • It has been revealed that pre-registration is open on the official website for all platforms.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Heartopia developer XD Games has delivered the news anyone who tried out the life sim game had been waiting for. The Animal Crossing-like cozy multiplayer game will finally arrive on January 7 across Android, iOS, and PC - with one caveat.

According to recent reports, the Steam version won’t actually launch on that date, and will instead go live at some other point in the future. You will be able to play it on PC through TapTap, which is the same emulator you may be familiar with from beta.

It has been revealed that pre-registration is open on the official website for all platforms. If you throw in your email address, you’ll receive a bundle of in-game items at launch. You’ll get 4,000 Gold, 20 Wishing Stars, 400 Moonlight Crystal, and 60 Exhibition Passes.

Interestingly, XD Games isn’t saying what you can expect from the launch build - in terms of content - just yet. Those details will be revealed closer to the January launch, so perhaps expect them in the first few days of the year.

If you created a character in either (or both) of the recent closed beta tests, you’ll also receive the Blueberry Crossbody Bag in-game cosmetic. If you made it to level 18 in either test, you’ll also get the Star Mascot Head cosmetic. Both items will be available to claim at launch.

Scientists discover a hidden eye disease that slowly steals night vision

📅 22 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (1041 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Sciencedaily

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that A newly identified genetic eye disease can gradually interfere with night vision and the ability to see objects at the edges of the visual field.
  • An international research team, including scientists at the Scheie Eye Institute within the University of Pennsylvania's Perelman School of Medicine, traced the condition to a gene already associated with another form of vision loss.
  • Although the condition has not yet received an official name, researchers are calling it EFEMP1-associated late-onset retinal degeneration (L-ORD).
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that A newly identified genetic eye disease can gradually interfere with night vision and the ability to see objects at the edges of the visual field. The condition may be especially difficult to recognize because people can maintain good eyesight for much of their lives before noticeable problems develop.

An international research team, including scientists at the Scheie Eye Institute within the University of Pennsylvania's Perelman School of Medicine, traced the condition to a gene already associated with another form of vision loss. However, the two diseases affect eyesight in strikingly different ways. The previously known disorder primarily damages central vision, while the newly discovered condition affects peripheral vision and the ability to see in darkness.

Although the condition has not yet received an official name, researchers are calling it EFEMP1-associated late-onset retinal degeneration (L-ORD). It is linked to a specific genetic variant known as p.Arg140Trp in the EFEMP1 gene. This change causes an unusually thick accumulation of material between cells in the eye.

A Genetic Discovery That Began Decades Ago.

Sources indicate that the investigation traces back to 1998, when doctors documented an unusual pattern of vision loss in a family in the United States. As researchers uncovered new genetic evidence, they were able to connect those findings to families in Europe who highlighted similar symptoms.

The study, published in JAMA Ophthalmology, examined three unrelated families from different countries who carried the p.Arg140Trp variant. Their symptoms were compared with those of another family carrying a different change in the same gene, called p.Arg345Trp, which is associated with the previously recognized disease affecting central vision.

The international collaboration included researchers from Penn Medicine, the University of Edinburgh, the University of Basel, Charles University, and the University of Bonn.

At first, scientists suspected that the unusual symptoms in the original family might be caused by a different genetic disorder. Testing, however, failed to identify the variants responsible for that condition.

According to recent reports, "The different disease expression in this family was thought to be similar to a condition caused by C1QTNF5 gene variants. However, none of the variants associated with that disease were found," said Artur V. Cideciyan, PhD, an ophthalmology researcher and co-director of the Center for Hereditary Retinal Degenerations. "Our collaborators then discovered a new variant in the EFEMP1 gene that normally causes a different disease where the macula, which is tied to central vision, is affected first.".

How the Fresh Eye Disease Affects Night Vision.

Sources indicate that the researchers found that the newly identified condition develops gradually in the outer regions of the retina. Located at the back of the eye, the retina detects incoming light and transforms it into signals that the brain uses to create visual images.

Unlike the previously known EFEMP1 disorder, which initially affects the macula and central vision, this newly identified disease begins in the peripheral retina. People may see normally for much of their lives before gradually noticing that their side vision is narrowing or that seeing in dim surroundings has become more difficult.

Problems may be particularly noticeable around dusk or at night, when the eyes must rely more heavily on specialized light-sensitive cells called rods.

Industry observers note that one reason the disease is challenging to diagnose is that these cells may initially show no visible structural damage. The gradual progression of symptoms can make the condition even harder to recognize.

Sources indicate that however, the researchers identified a potentially valuable early clue. In affected individuals, rod cells take unusually long to recover when the eyes move from bright surroundings into darkness. This abnormal response can be detected even when the retina still appears structurally normal.

It has been revealed that "We can detect a major abnormality in the way rod photoreceptors recover in darkness with retinas that still look structurally intact," Cideciyan said. "This gives us a functional marker of disease at a stage when photoreceptor cells have not yet been lost.".

The finding suggests that changes in how the retina functions may reveal the disease before the light-sensitive cells responsible for vision begin to disappear.

What the Discovery Could Mean for Age-Related Vision Loss.

An vital question remains unanswered: How many people carry this newly identified genetic variant?

It has been revealed that researchers suspect the condition is relatively uncommon, but they do not yet have enough information to determine its prevalence. Larger investigations will be necessary to establish how frequently the variant occurs and how many people may be affected.

Beyond identifying another inherited eye disorder, the findings could help scientists better understand why vision deteriorates with age. Studying rare genetic diseases can reveal biological processes that may also contribute to much more widespread retinal conditions.

In a recent development, "Aging is a risk factor for many medical conditions, including retinal diseases such as age-related macular degeneration, the most common retinal condition of aging," said Tomas S. Aleman, MD, a professor of ophthalmology and the other co-director of the Center for Hereditary Retinal Degenerations. "Lessons learned from these infrequent, late-onset genetic eye diseases offer glimpses at possible mechanisms of disease for much more frequent retinal problems.".

According to recent reports, by revealing how different changes in a single gene can produce distinct patterns of vision loss, the research adds to scientists' understanding of inherited retinal disease. It also highlights the potential importance of detecting changes in visual function before damage becomes apparent in the retina's structure.

The study received support from the University of Edinburgh Chancellor's Fellowship award, RS Macdonald Charitable Trust Seedcorn Award, the BrightFocus Foundation (M2024009N), the German Research Foundation (532367710), the Medical Research Council (MC_UU_00035/9, MC_UU_00007/10), the Swiss National Science Foundation (204285), the Ministry of Health of the Czech Republic (NW24-06-00083), Charles University in Prague (UNCE/24/MED/022 and SVV 2600631), and the Samuel G. Jacobson, MD, PhD, Memorial Fund.

Materials provided by University of Pennsylvania School of Medicine. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.

It has been revealed that according to NBC, Zampella’s Ferrari hit a concrete barrier after leaving a tunnel in the San Gabriel Mountains, north of Los Angeles. Zampella was unfortunately trapped in an ensuing car fire, and the passenger was ejected.

Industry observers note that vince Zampella is one of the industry’s most prolific creators. His storied career is long, and is responsible for some of the biggest shooter franchises in history. It started with Medal of Honor in the 90s, a game that changed WW2 shooters forever.

Sources indicate that zampella later co-founded the legendary Infinity Ward in 2002, the team that would go on to redefine multiplayer shooters forever. Infinity Ward is the studio responsible for the Call of Duty series, which remains one of the biggest games for publisher Activision, and the entire industry.

In a recent development, zampella then left the studio he founded in 2010 following a major fallout with Activision. He, along with longtime collaborator, Jason West, went to rival publisher EA to form Respawn Entertainment.

Recent findings suggest that respawn went on to create the Titanfall series, and later Apex Legends. The studio is responsible for non-shooters, of course, like the third-person action game series Star Wars Jedi. Zampella was instrumental in making the game possible, having hired God of War 3 director Stig Asmussen to helm a team within Respawn out of a desire to diversify the studio’s output and prove he can do more than make shooters.

Zampella had only recently met with journalists and peers at The Game Awards, where Battlefield 6 was nominated for multiple awards. Battlefield 6 is the most successful game in series history, in part as a result of Zampella’s leadership. The legendary leader was given the reigns of the struggling multiplayer shooter franchise in 2021, with a goal of finding a viable future.

Zampella’s sudden death has shaken the industry, and many mourn his loss as the news started spreading.

“We are heartbroken by the loss of Vince Zampella, a creative leader whose work shaped generations of players and helped define what modern shooters and action games could be,” EA remarked in a statement.

Recent findings suggest that “While his impact reached far beyond any one game or studio, we will remember Vince for how he showed up every day, trusting his teams, encouraging bold ideas, and believing in Battlefield and the people building it. We are deeply grateful for his leadership, his generosity, and the care he brought to everything he touched, and we will carry that forward with us.”.

#98359. Breaking: A common blood pressure drug has a surprising effect on calorie-burning brown fat

Breaking: A common blood pressure drug has a surprising effect on calorie-burning brown fat

📅 22 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1191 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Sciencedaily

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • A widely used blood pressure medication may have an unexpected benefit beyond its ability to control hypertension.
  • Losartan belongs to a class of medications called angiotensin receptor blockers (ARB), which have an established safety profile.
  • Sources indicate that the findings also revealed a surprising connection between brown fat and mental health.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A widely used blood pressure medication may have an unexpected benefit beyond its ability to control hypertension. Scientists have found that losartan can activate brown fat, a specialized type of body fat that burns energy, and improve metabolic activity in mice. The discovery suggests that an existing medication could potentially be repurposed to stimulate brown fat and support metabolic health.

Losartan belongs to a class of medications called angiotensin receptor blockers (ARB), which have an established safety profile. In a newly introduced study published in Nature, researchers found that the drug increased brown fat activity through a biological mechanism separate from its blood pressure effects. This raises the possibility of developing treatments that activate brown fat without lowering blood pressure.

Sources indicate that the findings also revealed a surprising connection between brown fat and mental health. After examining data from more than 100,000 patients, researchers discovered that people with detectable brown fat had lower rates of several medical conditions, including anxiety and depression. This is the first time the research team has reported associations between brown fat and psychiatric health, adding to earlier evidence linking the tissue to better cardiovascular and metabolic health.

Industry observers note that the research was led by Paul Cohen at Rockefeller University's Laboratory of Molecular Metabolism, working with Heiko Schöder and Daniel Lafontaine from Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC). It expands on research published in 2021, when Cohen's team analyzed approximately 50,000 patients and found that those with more brown fat had substantially lower odds of developing cardiometabolic conditions such as coronary artery disease and type II diabetes.

"We only looked for a few diagnostic codes in that study, mainly focusing on cardiovascular disease since that's what this tissue has historically been associated with," notes Cohen. "The scope of this newly introduced analysis is far more expansive. We doubled our number of patients and considered more than 500 codes, which allowed us to unearth many new insights.".

AI Analysis Reveals New Benefits of Brown Fat.

To investigate brown fat's relationship with human health, the researchers examined PET/CT scans from more than 100,000 patients who had undergone imaging as part of their cancer monitoring. They focused on scans showing brown adipose tissue, which can be found in six regions of the body, including the neck, armpits, and areas around organs such as the heart and kidneys.

Sources indicate that the team used an approach known as reverse translation, which begins with observations in patients and then investigates the biological processes responsible for them. Cohen's laboratory has previously used this strategy to uncover important details about brown fat and its effects on health.

Sources indicate that nicolás Gómez-Banoy, the study's first author and an endocrinologist and instructor in clinical investigation in Cohen's laboratory, used a machine learning system developed by researchers at MSKCC to measure brown fat activity. The technology allowed him to assess both the total activity in each patient and the activity within each of the six anatomical regions.

Industry observers note that the analysis showed that brown fat's location could be just as notable as its presence. Activity in particular regions appeared to have stronger associations with certain health conditions, suggesting that brown fat may influence the body differently depending on where it is found.

Sources indicate that "For example, the axillary, or armpit, area was linked to a decreased risk of high blood pressure compared to other regions," he says. "But overall, patients with brown fat have better glycemic parameters, lipid profiles, and echocardiographic indices, as well as lower inflammatory markers.".

These findings indicate that people with brown fat tend to have healthier blood sugar levels, blood fat profiles, measures of heart function, and indicators of inflammation.

Common Blood Pressure Drug Activates Brown Fat.

As the researchers investigated medications associated with brown fat activity, they noticed an intriguing pattern. Patients taking angiotensin receptor blockers were more likely to have detectable brown fat on their scans, suggesting that these widely prescribed medications might influence the tissue.

According to recent reports, to explore that possibility, the team conducted laboratory experiments using cultured brown fat cells. They found that losartan directly increased the cells' metabolic activity, providing evidence that the drug could stimulate brown fat rather than simply being associated with its presence.

It has been revealed that even more interestingly, the researchers discovered that losartan activated brown fat through molecular pathways different from those responsible for lowering blood pressure. That distinction could be especially valuable for developing future medications that target metabolism without interfering with normal blood pressure regulation.

It has been revealed that "The fact that its different effects are mediated by different molecular pathways is advantageous, since it means we could potentially isolate them in future therapies," says Gómez-Banoy. "That way you would be able to stimulate brown fat in people with normal blood pressure.".

Additional experiments in healthy mice strengthened the findings. Animals given losartan showed increased energy expenditure, consumed more oxygen, and produced more carbon dioxide, all signs of heightened metabolic activity. Despite these changes, their body weight remained stable.

Brown Fat's Surprising Connection to Mental Health.

Beyond its metabolic effects, brown fat may have a previously unrecognized relationship with psychological well-being. The patient analysis revealed that individuals with detectable brown fat had lower rates of anxiety and depression, extending the tissue's potential health associations beyond the cardiovascular system.

"We know that metabolically healthy people tend to have lower incidence of psychiatric diseases, so it could be that having brown fat makes you more metabolically healthy, and this correlates with fewer psychiatric issues," claims Gómez-Banoy.

Recent findings suggest that the researchers also found an intriguing relationship involving selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, or SSRIs, medications commonly prescribed to treat depression. These drugs appeared to suppress brown fat activity, suggesting another possible connection between psychiatric treatments and metabolic regulation.

However, the findings do not suggest that brown fat is beneficial in every respect. The analysis also identified higher rates of osteoporosis and certain skin diseases among people with brown fat, raising questions about possible trade-offs that require further investigation.

It has been revealed that the discoveries have opened several avenues for future research. Scientists hope to examine the genetics of people with particularly high brown fat activity, investigate why the tissue is associated with lower rates of anxiety and depression, and determine whether its apparent benefits can be harnessed safely.

Losartan may also be only one of several existing medications worth investigating. The extensive patient analysis identified additional drugs associated with brown fat activity, offering researchers a range of potential candidates for future studies.

Recent findings suggest that "There were plenty of other medications associated with brown fat activity in our large cohort," Cohen notes. "This is just a start.".

Sources indicate that unfortunately, we are not allowed to have nice things in this timeline. According to a BBC report this morning, following a unanimous vote from the current Nvidia corporate board, Huang has been officially reinstated to his position as CEO. Yay.

According to the BBC report, despite previous insistences from the board that Huang would not be reinstated to his position, the ultimate conclusion that they came to is that only Huang could continue the AI-focused push Nvidia has been running with lately.

"The board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers," the board’s current chair said in a public statement on the Nvidia website.

The ultimate conclusion that they came to is that only Huang could continue the AI-focused push Nvidia has been running with lately.

Apparently, Huang’s return was orchestrated at least in part by United States President Donald Trump, who, in a brief interview with CNBC, mentioned that he “felt very strongly that [Huang] should come back, and we've done a very thorough investigation.

"And the investigation showed that he did - I mean, he had bad judgment having to do with somewhat unrelated incidents - but he did nothing wrong other than he created a chip that's invaluable.".

Following news of Huang’s reinstatement, Nvidia’s stock value bounced up 32%, a notable increase following a 13% drop-off at the end of last week.

In a personal statement on the Nvidia website, Huang said that he is “honoured to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a newly introduced industrial revolution.

“I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment.”.

According to recent reports, some analysts speculate that, particularly within the AI-centric tech field, figureheads have become an key part of the push. Parallels have been drawn between Huang’s reinstatement and that of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, who was reinstated in his own position just five days after being fired from it in 2023.

The BBC’s tech and AI analyst Zoe Kleinman posited on the matter, saying that “It states a lot that despite the serious accusations made about him and his affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy, ultimately his position in the tech industry has proved to be more important:.

“There had been many calls for him to be reinstated - including from within the UK House of Lords - on the grounds that the AI industry would be weaker without him.”.

It has been revealed that whatever the precise reason, it’s probably a safe bet that Nvidia will promptly resume its previous course, which means those of us in the gaming sphere won’t be seeing any affordable GPUs any time soon. Oh well, it was nice to dream of a world where you didn't need to justify buying a top-shelf graphics card...

In a recent development, if you can believe it, Love and Deepspace is almost two-years-old, and Infold Games is celebrating the moment in a few major ways. The Throne of Eros update brings the game up to version 5.0, and it’s one for fans of all love interests.

It has been revealed that for one, this is the first time all five of them are brought together. The enhancement is also adding some key latest features, alongside anniversary events, and more.

Throne of Eros also doubles as the latest Wish Pool, which is the one that has all of the game’s love interests in a single banner. This is a limited-time affair, of course, but it’s not the only thing you should look forward to here.

There’s also the Memory Growth Bonus, another limited-time event that you can take advantage of to grow your Memories. The even bigger news is that you can target your Wishes through the Xspace Echo, which lets you select five Memories to create your own pool from. You can use this to get any Memories you might not have, of course.

On the topic of Memories, you’ll also be able to unlock upcoming second anniversary KV Memories, as part of a Yearly Highlights Event that will let you look back on your own journey with the game over the past year.

In a recent development, on the story and narrative side, Throne of Eros adds two upcoming main stories, with new branches for Xavier, and Rafayel. There’s even a narrative-specific event that will run throughout the anniversary period, through which you can earn two daily outfits for each of the five love interests.

Recent findings suggest that the celebrations also extend to upcoming anniversary content like mail, and video calls. You can purchase a Yearly Pass, and check out some new arrivals at the Lunar Shop.

Beyond the anniversary content, version 5.0 also adds a fresh feature to the game: Home, which essentially offers a hub to get you directly to interacting with love interests that doesn’t have to do with combat or story.

You can also expect various other quality of life updates that touch on the Journal, Phone Moments Search, Resources Quick Cleanup, and latest Tete-a-Tete that should make interacting with all of them more streamlined.

Sources indicate that while this is a special banner, you should brush up on how banners work in Love and Deepspace if you’re unfamiliar. As always, it’s never not a good idea to check our Love and Deepspace codes page for some freebies.

#98354. Guide: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Walkthrough (Switch 2 Remake): Guide To The Main Quest, Side Quests & Collectables
